bugs.name: Deleting a wiki page that was already deleted in another tab answers 500 and gives the user no message
bugs.summary: The request POST /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent8-stale.-?action=_delete answers 500 Internal Server Error (console: "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500"), the dialog just closes, and the stale page view stays exactly as it was — the page body "stale tab test content" and the Delete Page button are still shown with no error message, although the page no longer exists. Clicking Delete Page → Yes again in the same tab gives the same 500 and the same silent result. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent8-stale.-)
bugs.expected: Either the delete is detected as already done and the tab tells the user the page was deleted (e.g. "page does not exist" and a way back to the wiki), or at worst it reports that the deletion failed. It must not fail with a server error and no message.
bugs.actual: The request POST /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent8-stale.-?action=_delete answers 500 Internal Server Error (console: "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500"), the dialog just closes, and the stale page view stays exactly as it was — the page body "stale tab test content" and the Delete Page button are still shown with no error message, although the page no longer exists. Clicking Delete Page → Yes again in the same tab gives the same 500 and the same silent result.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and create a wiki page named "agent8-stale" with the body "stale tab test content" (New Page on /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki).
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent8-stale.- in two browser tabs (tab A and tab B).
In tab A click the red "Delete Page" button and "Yes" in the dialog; the page is deleted and tab A goes back to the wiki Home page.
Switch to tab B, which still shows the page, click its red "Delete Page" button and "Yes" in the dialog.
